I just bought two.

Yes, it's pricey for a promo card, but I've been donating to Rothfuss' Worldbuilders charity for a couple of years now anyway, so I'm just considering it part of this year's contribution.  I'll probably donate some more straight to the campaign so I can get some tickets for raffle too.  They've already got over 1,500 items in the raffle, including some very neat stuff -- Details at: www.worldbuilders.org

As for the Kvothe/AA connections, it's so obvious in retrospect that I'm annoyed I hadn't thought of it earlier.  My assumption is that Kvothe is not an earlier Virtuoso of the Void, but is the Virtuoso from an alternate dimension who has teamed-up with the F5 during some crisis event (it is called Sentinels of the _Multiverse_, after all).

...

Oh man... thinking about alternate universe versions of SotM characters led me down a rabbit hole of ideas and so I've started a tread for it over in the Sentinels Comics forum.

posts.name: grysqrl
posts.cooked: Terraforming

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
Worldbuilders is the name of the group of authors that Patrick Rothfuss rounds up to donate stuff for his charity raffle & auction.  The proceeds from those are donated to Heifer International, a nonprofit that distributes animals, along with agricultural training, to families in need around the world as a means of providing self-sufficiency. 

They're a pretty rescpected charity organization.  You can read about them at: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heifer_International

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Got Mine this morning.

My Goodness, Adept is insane with this card.

Turned a horrible turn vs. Voss into a nothing turn, Tempest put Forced Deployment on top with Stratosphere, then Adept Vernaled to put Strat on top of Tempest's deck, then used Sympathy to  play Stratosphere, which put Conqueror on top of Voss's deck, then discarded the conqueror from Voss's Deck.

It was a great turn.

It also works insanely well with Alacritous Subdominant, since you can Vernal songs or instruments to the top of your deck then put them in play and use them in the same power chain, get an ally a key power back on top of their deck then put it in play and let them use it, or throw a DDA into the middle of a power chain.

Just Wow, the number of shenanigans this card allows.
